event.title: Add reward calculation helper
event.body: Adds a new `calculateRewards()` helper in `src/rewards.py` and calls it from the existing login path. The function is defined in this PR.
event.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/rewards.py
@@
+def calculateRewards(user):
+    return user.points * 2
--- a/src/auth.py
+++ b/src/auth.py
@@
 def login(user, pw):
+    calculateRewards(user)
     return True
